title: Handoff and Triage Lab Notes — Customer Integrations (weekly)
content:
Meeting: SE + ProServices weekly lab handoff
Date: 2027-06-07 10:00 PT 
Attendees: Aisha V, Marco C, Riley T, Pooja N, Samir P, L. Nguyen (FieldEng)

Objective: quick triage + handoff of customer integration work that needs either engineering/design or proservices operational runway. Try to keep items <15m each.

Top-line summary:
- Two green customer rollouts (Lumera, Polaris) progressing through canary with minor perf diffs; still on-track for mid-June GA.
- Veridian has a persistent KV-cache miss rate spike after sequence_length bump; investigating kernel selection fallback causing slow path on some shards.
- Tidewater onboarding blocked on network peering + cert rotation in customer VPC; proservices cannot run full e2e due to inaccessible metrics endpoint.
- One deep-dive scheduled next Tues for quant profile regressions noticed in QA for model xg-1.5q.

Notes / discussion items:
1) Veridian — cache miss spike (owner: Marco)
- Symptom: after bumping client sequence_length target from 1024->2048, observed KV cache hit drop 82%->56% on long-tail requests (measured 2027-06-05 morning).
- Immediate impact: tail latency 95p increased 2.4x during burst windows; customer downstream job retries increased.
- Hypothesis: runtime selected different attention kernel for >1024 path; also cache sharding boundaries not aligned with new chunking.
- Action items:
  - Marco to capture per-shard kernel selection logs and upload to /se/diagnostics by EOD 2027-06-08 (JIRA-4823).
  - Engineering to test forced kernel pin (old path) on a replica to verify delta — Samir to run experiment in staging pool by 2027-06-09.
  - ProServices to enable temporary rate-limiter rule to smooth client backoff while root cause is investigated (Pooja).
- Notes to self: check whether model variant fallback (xg-1.5 -> xg-1.5q) happened during the same windows — could be confounding.

2) Tidewater — VPC peering + cert rotation (owner: Riley)
- Blocker: TLS certificate rotation scheduled by customer but their NAT gateway misconfigured; telemetry endpoint (prometheus push gateway) unreachable from our handoff container.
- Required from customer: new peering CIDR + confirmation that ports 9091 and 443 are open from Redwood uplink.
- Short-term mitigation: ask for an SSH jumpbox or temporary set of public endpoints to run e2e.
- Action items:
  - Riley to send peering checklist + minimal test commands to Tidewater infra lead (ticket created: JIRA-4899) by 2027-06-07.
  - FieldEng L. Nguyen to coordinate maintenance window for cert rotation on 2027-06-10.
- Risk: if peering not fixed prior to scheduled dedicated capacity start (2027-06-14), we will need to postpone capacity commit and notify Sales.

3) Lumera — canary metrics and trace anomalies (owner: Pooja)
- Canary is 10% traffic; CPU utilization fine, but one customer endpoint shows rarer 503s (~0.02% requests) during peak hour.
- Traces indicate occasionally hitting a fast-fail circuit in the customer adapter (their side).
- Action items:
  - Pooja to escalate with FieldEng and get adapter team to instrument additional logs.
  - Add a retry policy for that route (2 retries, jittered) at the Redwood routing layer as a temporary mitigation (Samir).
- Success criteria: 503 rate <0.005% for 48h window before we expand canary.

4) Polaris — rollout checklist and A/B variant plan (owner: Samir)
- Polaris asked for A/B between xg-1.5 (baseline) and xg-1.5q (quantized).
- Requirements: automated quality eval on internal prompt set, cost delta estimate, and monitoring for hallucination metrics.
- Action items:
  - Samir to push evaluation harness and initial baseline metrics to GH PR (github.com/redwood-inference/qa/pulls/125) by 2027-06-09.
  - SE to prepare rollback playbook and alert thresholds for auto-fallback.

5) xg-1.5q quant regressions — spike in hallucination rate in QA (owner: Aisha)
- Observed: specific instruction-following prompts degraded on quantized variant; failure mode is semantic drift on list generation.
- Investigation plan: run paired diff eval (full precision vs quant) with same seeds; collect token-level divergence stats.
- Action items:
  - Aisha to run diff eval job and upload CSV results to Confluence page (linked) by 2027-06-11.
  - If regression > 3% on critical prompt set, hold rollout and notify product.

Operational items / runbook checks:
- Dedicated pool capacity health: current utilization 67% across SE-dedicated-west (alerts auto-configured for >80%). No action now but watch for June 14 commit for Tidewater.
- Canary monitoring: ensure rollout monitors include prefix-cache-hit, latency_p95, token-rate, and hallucination_count. Riley to confirm dashboards in Console by 2027-06-09.
- Incident readiness: brief SRE on potential cache-related incidents; Samir to draft runbook snippet.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Who owns decision threshold for reverting a quantized variant? (Engineering or Product?) We need a short policy. Suggestion: engineering veto if latency or hallucination exceeds threshold; product veto for quality regressions. Capture in product-hosted-api backlog.
- Can we add a small synthetic load test to staging that mirrors long sequence tails? Current staging load generator does not produce enough 2k+ sequences. (Action: Marco to extend loadgen config.)

Action items (summary):
- Marco Chen: collect kernel-selection logs for Veridian (due 2027-06-08) [JIRA-4823].
- Samir Patel: run forced-kernel experiment in staging and prepare rollback playbook (due 2027-06-09).
- Riley Taylor: send peering checklist to Tidewater and confirm dashboards (due 2027-06-07 / 2027-06-09).
- Pooja Nair: escalate Lumera adapter logs and coordinate with FieldEng (due 2027-06-08).
- Aisha Verma: run paired diff eval for quant regressions and report (due 2027-06-11).

Misc notes / scratchpad (informal):
- Quick thought: maybe we should expose a "sequence_length_preference" hint in the API to avoid runtime surprises — put on backlog.
- Possible quick win: add a per-route small-token cache to reduce burst misses for long contexts (needs cost analysis).
- Reminder: update SE/handbook with new kernel-selection debug steps.

Next meeting: 2027-06-14 10:00 PT (same channel). Plan to review Veridian experiment results and Tidewater peering status.

File attachments referenced: Veridian kernel logs (s3://redwood-se/diagnostics/veridian/2027-06-05.log), Lumera canary traces (Confluence link), Polaris eval PR link.

End notes: rough/working doc; will tidy and move critical items to JIRA + Confluence. If anything missing ping me in #se-proservices.
